resources.string: Enter the address of the DSH host on your local network and the 8-character pairing code shown on the PC.
Checking the connection to the PC…
The address and code are shown on the PC at http://127.0.0.1:PORT/m/pair. If the port is omitted, 3081 is used.
HTTP is used on the local network, so traffic is not encrypted. Prefer HTTPS when the DSH host has a certificate.
The pairing code must be exactly 8 characters, or left empty.
Only http:// and https:// addresses are supported.
The address could not be parsed. Example: http://192.168.1.10:3081
The port must be between 1 and 65535.
The PC answered with HTTP %1$d. Check that the DSH mobile plugin is enabled and listening.
The PC is unreachable. Check Wi-Fi, the address and that the DSH host is running.
The PC response is not a valid DSH mobile handshake.
Unsupported protocol version (%1$s). Update DSH Mobile or the DSH plugin.
Unknown error while checking the PC.
No bundled copy is available. Run android/scripts/sync-web.ps1 and rebuild the APK, or connect to a PC.
Unencrypted HTTP channel: other devices on the local network can read this traffic.
Bundled copy: data may be stale

DSH Mobile %1$s

Android WebView client for DeepSeek Harness over the local network.
Mobile API protocol v1.

CI builds are unsigned. Install only builds you trust.
Check that the DSH host is running and that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi network.
The TLS certificate of the PC is not trusted by this device. Use HTTP on the LAN or install a trusted certificate on the PC.
